nodes.description: msg.sender used for authorization checks in MultiSig (isSigner), Restricted (permissions) and as the executor/beneficiary in AugmintToken fee flows
MultiSig._execute performs scriptAddress.delegatecall.gas(gasleft()-23000)(...) executing arbitrary untrusted code in the MultiSig storage context
ecrecover in ECRecovery.recover derives the signer address from a raw signature
inline assembly blocks: returndatacopy/revert in MultiSig.dryExecute and r/s/v mload extraction in ECRecovery.recover
to.transfer(weiAmount) sends raw ETH to an arbitrary address in SystemAccount.withdraw
MultiSig mapping(address=>bool) of active signers; gates sign/execute
MultiSig address[] of all signers ever added (may contain duplicates)
MultiSig uint count of currently active signers, basis of the quorum calculation
MultiSig mapping(address=>Script) holding state, signCount, signedBy and signers for each script
MultiSig address[] of registered script addresses used for UI enumeration
Restricted mapping(address=>mapping(bytes32=>bool)) permission registry
AugmintToken mapping(address=>uint256) token balances
AugmintToken allowance mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256))
AugmintToken total supply, mutated by issueTo and burn
AugmintToken TransferFeeInterface used to compute transfer fees
AugmintToken mapping(bytes32=>bool) replay protection for delegated transfers
FeeAccount TransferFee struct (pt/min/max) used by calculateTransferFee
MultiSig.sign(address) records a signer approval and transitions a script to Approved on quorum
MultiSig.execute(address) signer-only entrypoint that delegates execution of an Approved script
MultiSig.dryExecute(address) publicly callable dry-run that always reverts, bubbling delegatecall revert data via assembly
MultiSig.cancelScript(address) self-only function marking a script Cancelled
MultiSig.addSigners(address[]) self-only function adding new signers
MultiSig.removeSigners(address[]) self-only function removing signers, never the last one
MultiSig.checkQuorum(uint) internal view abstract hook implemented by derived contracts
MultiSig._execute(address) private function performing the delegatecall and updating script state to Done/Failed
StabilityBoardProxy.checkQuorum requires signersCount > activeSignersCount/2
Restricted.grantPermission(address,bytes32) writes a permission, gated by PermissionGranter
Restricted.grantMultiplePermissions(address,bytes32[]) loops over grantPermission
Restricted.revokePermission(address,bytes32) clears a permission
Restricted.revokeMultiplePermissions(address,bytes32[]) loops over revokePermission
ECRecovery.recover(bytes32,bytes) parses r/s/v via assembly and returns the recovered address
AugmintToken.delegatedTransfer builds a txHash, verifies the offline signature and transfers the tokens plus executor fee
AugmintToken private helper validating the requested fee, replay hash and signature, then paying the executor
AugmintToken.transferAndNotify transfers then calls transferNotification on an arbitrary TokenReceiver
AugmintToken.delegatedTransferAndNotify transfers and notifies an arbitrary TokenReceiver based on a signed instruction
AugmintToken.issueTo(address,uint) mints tokens, restricted to MonetarySupervisor
AugmintToken.burn(uint) burns the caller's own tokens
AugmintToken private _transfer/_transfer(fee) updating balances, fees and emitting events
AugmintToken private _transferFrom checking allowance plus fee then deducting
SystemAccount.withdraw transfers tokens out and sends ETH, restricted to StabilityBoard
FeeAccount.calculateTransferFee computes the fee from transferFee and NoTransferFee permissions
Main0035_aeur_reserve_transfer.execute delegatecallable script that checks address(this) is the StabilityBoardProxy then withdraws the FeeAccount ETH balance
address[] signers parameter of addSigners/removeSigners
address scriptAddress parameter indexing the scripts mapping
bytes signature parameter forwarded to ECRecovery.recover

address to parameter, recipient of tokens or ETH

edges.reason: sign() requires isSigner[msg.sender] before accepting a signature
execute() requires isSigner[msg.sender] to prevent griefing an approved script
dryExecute() has no signer check and is callable by any msg.sender (always reverts)
cancelScript() requires msg.sender == address(this), i.e. only via multisig self-call
addSigners() requires msg.sender == address(this)
removeSigners() requires msg.sender == address(this)
grantPermission() requires permissions[msg.sender][PermissionGranter]
revokePermission() requires permissions[msg.sender][PermissionGranter]
issueTo mints to 'to' and is gated by the MonetarySupervisor restrict modifier on msg.sender
burn() debits balances[msg.sender], caller scoped to own balance
withdraw() is gated by restrict(StabilityBoard) on msg.sender
_checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee pays the executor fee to msg.sender
Main0035.execute is invoked through StabilityBoardProxy delegatecall so msg.sender is the proxy
sign() reads isSigner[msg.sender] as the authorization gate
sign() loads and mutates the Script struct from scripts[scriptAddress]
sign() pushes a new scriptAddress into the scriptAddresses array on first signature
sign() calls checkQuorum, resolved to the StabilityBoardProxy implementation
checkQuorum compares signersCount against activeSignersCount/2
execute() calls _execute which performs a delegatecall to a user-supplied script address
dryExecute() calls the same _execute delegatecall path without any signature requirement
_execute delegatecalls the untrusted scriptAddress, handing full control and MultiSig storage to arbitrary code
_execute writes ScriptState.Done/Failed into scripts[scriptAddress] after the delegatecall returns
dryExecute bubbles the delegatecall revert reason using inline assembly returndatacopy/revert
delegatedTransfer builds txHash then calls _checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee before transferring
_checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee recovers the signer with ECRecovery.recover to validate the signature
_checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee marks delegatedTxHashesUsed[txHash] to block replay
recover() returns the address produced by the low-level ecrecover precompile
recover() extracts r, s and v from the signature bytes using inline assembly mload
transferAndNotify transfers first and then calls transferNotification on an arbitrary TokenReceiver holding msg.sender context
delegatedTransferAndNotify performs an external transferNotification call to a user-chosen receiver after transferring
_transfer performs balances[from].sub(amountWithFee) and balances[to].add(transferAmount)
_transfer reads feeAccount to compute the transfer fee before updating balances
_transferFrom checks and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] by amount plus fee
_transferFrom requires balances[from] >= amount.add(fee) and relies on the checked add
issueTo increases totalSupply via totalSupply.add(amount)
burn decreases totalSupply via totalSupply.sub(amount)
withdraw sends ETH with to.transfer(weiAmount) to a caller-supplied address
withdraw invokes tokenAddress.transferWithNarrative which internally uses the _transfer logic
calculateTransferFee reads transferFee.pt/min/max to bound the computed fee
calculateTransferFee consults permissions[from/to][NoTransferFee] to waive the fee
Main0035.execute calls FEE_ACCOUNT.withdraw to move the FeeAccount ETH balance to TARGET_ADDRESS
addSigners sets isSigner[signers[i]] = true and pushes into allSigners
addSigners increments activeSignersCount for each newly added signer
removeSigners sets isSigner[signers[i]] = false
removeSigners decrements activeSignersCount, guarded by activeSignersCount > 1
cancelScript sets scripts[scriptAddress].state to Cancelled
grantPermission writes permissions[agent][requiredPermission] = true
revokePermission writes permissions[agent][requiredPermission] = false
grantMultiplePermissions loops and calls grantPermission per requested permission
revokeMultiplePermissions loops and calls revokePermission per requested permission
the scriptAddress parameter indexes scripts[scriptAddress] and is passed to _execute
the signature parameter is forwarded to ECRecovery.recover inside _checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee
the signers array parameter is iterated over in addSigners to update isSigner and activeSignersCount
the amount parameter feeds the checked add/sub balance updates in _transfer
the to parameter is the ETH recipient of the raw to.transfer call in withdraw
the agent parameter becomes the key of the permissions mapping in grantPermission/revokePermission
the requiredPermission parameter is the second permissions mapping key
the recovered local variable is compared against the expected signer before paying the executor fee

normalization_plan.reason: address[] signers parameter only exists to drive the addSigners/removeSigners signer-set update loops; fold into the addSigners node
scriptAddress parameter is the lookup key consumed by MultiSig.execute; fold into the execute function node
signature parameter is validated inside _checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee via ECRecovery.recover; fold into that private function node
amount parameter flows directly into the balances arithmetic of _transfer; fold into the _transfer node
to parameter is the ETH/token recipient handled by SystemAccount.withdraw; fold into the withdraw node
agent parameter is the permissions mapping key written by grantPermission/revokePermission; fold into the grantPermission node
requiredPermission parameter is the second permissions mapping key written by grantPermission; fold into the grantPermission node
the recovered local variable is a temporary result inside _checkHashAndTransferExecutorFee; fold into that private function node
